        self.data = [default]*self.l + data + [default]*(self.l-N)
        for i in range(self.l-1,0,-1):
            self.data[i] = op(self.data[2*i], self.data[2*i+1])

    def set(self,i,val):

        self.data[i] = val
        i = i//2
        while i > 0:
